thesis: The bull narrowly carries a measured trend-and-quality purchase case because delivered growth, FCF above net income, lower debt and an intact trend are mutually supporting observations. This is a medium-confidence buy candidate, not a bargain valuation or urgent instruction to chase; the strongest timing and legal objections remain explicit.
strongest_counterexample: The stock is already 19.98% above SMA200 with a negative MACD histogram, operating margin below the year-ago observation and no authenticated valuation discount while court approval remains unresolved.
invalidation_conditions: Invalidate the positive trend component after five consecutive closes below SMA200.
Invalidate the operating-quality component if two reported quarters show year-over-year revenue decline or negative FCF.
Reassess immediately on a final court decision imposing a quantified material obligation outside the current disclosed settlement framework.
evidence_gaps: Authenticated valuation, net debt and debt-maturity context.
Final court outcome and company-specific settlement economics.
Verified expected-return estimate; none is supplied by the MA ranking.
decisive_factors: Comparable revenue/profit growth with strong FCF conversion.
Price remains above SMA50 and SMA200; short-term cooling limits confidence rather than erasing the trend.
